wallet_deployed.meaning: BuilderFactory.deployBuilder() has deployed a BuilderWallet and called init(legitimateAdmin)

fees_accumulated.meaning: builder fees have accumulated in the wallet over time

builder_admin_set.meaning: builderAdmin is already set on the BuilderWallet

reinit_allowed.meaning: BuilderWallet.init() succeeds in re-initializing although builderAdmin is already set

sweep_after_becoming_admin.meaning: sweep() is called after the caller became admin and transfers all wallet tokens

assumptions: The wallet was deployed and initialized with legitimateAdmin by the factory before the attacker's init call.
Fees have accumulated in the wallet before the attacker's sweep.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker's init overwrites an existing admin or whether init was already called; the reinit_allowed symbol encodes the report-claimed forbidden re-initialization scenario only.
Report does not specify the exact access-control guard (onlyFactory vs constructor-set admin) as a single required property; authorization is represented as builderAdmin already set.

limitations: The impact is potential; sweep_after_becoming_admin is a conditional witness, not an inevitable outcome.
No concrete token balance is bound; the sweep effect is represented as a Boolean occurrence rather than a numeric amount.
The authorization guard is approximated by builder_admin_set being false; the report does not fix the exact guard mechanism.
